hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$json = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $cmd = $json.toolCall.args.CommandLine; if ($cmd -match 'git push.*--force|rm -rf /|drop database|format [a-zA-Z]:') { Write-Output '{\"decision\":\"deny\",\"reason\":\"Destructive command blocked by safety-gate hook.\"}' } else { Write-Output '{\"decision\":\"allow\"}' }"

Stop.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$json = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; if (Test-Path 'docs/current-task.md') { Write-Output '{\"decision\":\"stop\"}' } else { Write-Output '{\"decision\":\"continue\",\"reason\":\"Mandatory docs/current-task.md file is missing. Please create it before stopping.\"}' }"
